turns.text: ABDM-2406 Invalid API sequence flow, please follow logical flow

must_contain: ABDM-2406 means the call does not fit where the gateway believes the flow is, for example the next step was sent before the previous step's callback arrived.
Find your last confirmed callback and resume from the step after it, rather than retrying the rejected call in place.
